## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the support problem it addresses.

## Privacy and permissions

- [ ] No external requests, telemetry, or analytics were added.
- [ ] No cookie, storage value, form, or password access was added.
- [ ] Manifest permissions remain minimal, or the change is justified below.
- [ ] Page-controlled values are rendered with `textContent`.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] Extension loaded from `dist/`
- [ ] Popup behavior verified on an HTTP or HTTPS test page
